Overhead close-up of a woman with eyes closed reclining back into turquoise pool water, arms outstretched, water droplets around her face.
A woman in a black tank top practices alternate-nostril breathing (pranayama) outdoors with eyes closed, palm trees and greenery behind her.
A woman relaxes on a green velvet sofa in a lounge, watching a large wall-mounted TV showing a mountain scene. Glass walls with warm ambient lighting surround the room.
Aerial view of two people doing shoulderstand yoga poses on mats atop an open rooftop terrace, overlooking dense green forest canopy. An outdoor sofa and potted plants sit nearby.
A woman in a flowing yellow dress twirls barefoot on a bed of white pebbles in a bright skylit atrium with white columns and a sculptural stone ornament.
A colorful raw vegetable salad in a green ceramic bowl beside a glass of orange juice on a marble table, with a teal velvet chair and floral cushion behind.
Interior detail of a bedside nightstand with a green glass vase and a brass fluted wall sconce, dappled sunlight falling across the upholstered headboard and cream curtains.

description: A bright double-height interior lounge with a large skylight, two blue scalloped velvet chairs and a small round table, framed angel-wings artwork on the wall, and sliding glass doors opening to greenery.

View through a sliding glass door into a dining area with a wood table, cream upholstered chairs, and a cascading teal glass-bead chandelier. A potted anthurium plant sits in dappled sunlight on the polished floor.
Cream upholstered dining chairs around a wood table with green glass vessels, beside a diagonal-patterned wooden door and a textured sculptural wall panel, in warm raking sunlight.
A tattooed man plays acoustic guitar while a laughing woman in a blue and white dress sits beside him on rocks at the beach at sunset.
An abundant grazing-table spread of fresh fruit, flowers, cucumber sticks, crackers, and a bowl of bright pink beetroot dip garnished with microgreens.

En-suite bathroom with a glass sliding-door walk-in shower, wall-hung toilet with hand spray, beige stone-tile walls, and a vividly patterned Moroccan-style encaustic tile floor in terracotta, blue and ochre. A folded white towel sits on a counter at right.

A woman in a white off-shoulder top and tan trousers sits on the edge of a made bed, smiling toward camera. A green beaded necklace, a feathered hat and a red glass of juice are on the bed beside her in warm low light.

Bathroom detail showing a wall-hung toilet with hand spray, a concrete-look partition wall topped by a small potted succulent, a walk-in shower area, and a bathtub visible through a doorway. Patterned blue-and-ochre floor tiles line the floor.

Close, warm-lit candid of three people socializing; a smiling woman with a white flower in her hair and gold statement earrings is in focus at right, while a man and a second woman are softly out of focus. A green palm frond crosses the foreground.

Symmetrical front elevation of a white villa entrance with a portico of round columns, a white cross-latticed double door flanked by two seated stone lion statues, black carriage lamps, decorative jali screen panels, and a brick-paved forecourt framed by coconut palms.

Three people laugh together around a lavish tropical grazing table piled with fruit, crackers and tropical flowers, inside a bright double-height villa interior with a staircase and white columns behind them.

Rooftop plunge pool with a black mosaic-tiled sheer waterfall wall; a woman relaxes in a curved lounge chair while a man stands barefoot at the pool edge talking to her, set against a backdrop of dense green palm-covered hills under a clear sky.

Close-up of an abundant tropical food spread with whole pineapples, bananas, oranges, grapefruit, grapes, coconut, a bowl of creamy dip garnished with parsley, crackers, and a grilled whole fish, decorated with flowers on palm leaves.

Styled flat-lay on banana leaves showing two grey folded menu cards branded 'VILLA RAAG / HEALING NUTRITION' with a circular logo, resting on a speckled ceramic plate beside two glasses of white wine and sprigs of baby's breath.

Long wooden banquet table set with a tropical fruit and floral display on banana leaves, positioned against a sculptural cream textured feature wall accented with a cascading green stone/glass installation, over a tiled floor.
subjects: banquet table;fruit display;textured feature wall;green installation

description: View from a shaded terrace through white walls onto a plunge pool with a mosaic floral motif on its floor and a black mosaic sheer-descent waterfall wall, overlooking dense green palm and forest hills under a pale sky.
subjects: plunge pool;mosaic floral motif;waterfall wall;forest view

description: Candid over-the-shoulder shot of a smiling woman in a straw feathered hat and white off-shoulder top with a green beaded pendant necklace, greeting a man seen from behind, in a bright white villa entrance with potted plants and a tiled roof beyond.

A woman with curly hair in a yellow long-sleeve top sits at a wooden counter reading a paperback book while holding a green speckled ceramic mug, softly backlit by a curtained window with a small plate of biscuits nearby.

Interior corner detail with a teal velvet tufted wingback armchair and matching cushion beside a sheer-curtained window, an arched brass floor lamp with a white feather shade, and a pair of round nesting side tables holding a book.

A sitting corner with a curved cream channel-tufted sofa and matching cushion, a tall dark textured floor vase holding a large-leaf plant, and a wooden coffee table with two marble-and-brass candle holders. Light filters through a tall latticework screen window.
subjects: sofa;floor vase plant;coffee table;candle holders;lattice window

description: A close-up food plate: a stone bowl of bright pink beetroot hummus topped with mixed seeds and microgreens, surrounded by carrot sticks, crackers, almonds and cashews on a banana leaf.
A long wooden dining table set for twelve with cream fluted chairs and green glassware, beneath a green glass cascade chandelier and a large textured sculptural relief wall panel.
subjects: dining table;fluted chairs;glass chandelier;relief wall art;glassware

description: An aerial drone view of a white villa with a pink-tiled terrace and red parasol, surrounded by dense green tropical tree canopy and a lawn clearing.

A close-up of a bed corner with a grey channel-tufted upholstered headboard trimmed in brass, striped and patterned cushions, a hanging brass-and-globe pendant sconce, and a cream nightstand beside a potted palm.

A king bed with a grey channel-tufted headboard trimmed in brass, white linens with three textured cushions and a patterned runner, flanked by brass pendant sconces, a wooden nightstand and a tall potted palm by a window.

A bedroom with a low cream upholstered bed and rounded headboard, ochre patterned throw cushions, a small tea tray on the bed, brass wall sconces, and floral-patterned sheer curtains beside a glass door.

A spacious living room with two teal velvet wingback chairs, cream sofas, a marble coffee table, a shaggy rug, an arched brass floor lamp, a feather pendant light and a decorative floral chandelier, with a latticework window and wooden console.
A bright interior corridor with a glazed indoor planter garden on the left, a linear skylight overhead, a herringbone wood floor inlay, teal accent chairs and framed art along cream walls.

An evening view of a double-height central atrium with columns, a blue skylight above, a white pebble Zen garden with stone spheres and sculptures, a turquoise glass cascade chandelier, a sculptural relief wall and a long dining table where a woman in green stands.
The villa entrance exterior with a cream signage block reading 'VILLA RAAG' in gold lettering, white colonial-style columns, a glass-paned double door flanked by lion statues and tropical plants.

A bedroom with a grey upholstered bed and wooden-trimmed headboard, white bedding with cushions, a wooden writing desk with a fluted tub chair, a colourful fruit-themed painting, a shaggy rug, and beige curtains over a glass door.
A cozy window nook with a teal tufted velvet loveseat and floral cushions, floral-patterned drapes over two windows with garden views, a caged pendant lamp, a framed mirror and a desk phone.

A rooftop terrace with a private plunge pool with a floral mosaic bottom, potted palms, a black woven rattan daybed with a white cushion, a glass balustrade and views over dense green tropical treetops under a blue sky.
